description: The plot illustrates the activation value across different layers for several components. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick labels at intervals of 50. The first line, representing “attn_output”, is dashed and colored blue; it begins at approximately 10 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 5 at layer 5, then increases to approximately 160 at layer 22. The second line, representing “attn_residual”, is dotted and colored orange; it begins at approximately 10 at layer 0 and increases to approximately 170 at layer 22. The third line, representing “ffn_residual”, is solid and colored red; it begins at approximately 10 at layer 0 and increases to approximately 380 at layer 22.
